facts.fact: The ICT Authority, under KDEAP, held a two-day workshop with ministries, departments and agencies on 6-7 November 2025 on Government Enterprise Architecture and the national e-Government Interoperability Framework, and says it will develop and finalize the national GEA standards and interoperability framework, so none is yet final.
